label: Other known referent
description: A referent that is identifiable but does not yet have a controlled identifier.

label: Unclear referent
description: The available context does not support a reliable referent assignment.

label: Not applicable
description: Reserved for false-positive candidate matches.

label: Rwanda 1994
description: The 1994 genocide against the Tutsi in Rwanda and its aftermath.

label: Rwanda
description: Speeches invoking the mass killing of Tutsi in Rwanda and its aftermath as genocide or genocidal.

label: Bosnia and Srebrenica
description: Speeches invoking the war in Bosnia and Herzegovina, including the fall of Srebrenica and its commemorations, as genocide or genocidal.

label: Croatia and the Yugoslav wars
description: Speeches invoking the Yugoslav wars outside Bosnia and Kosovo as genocide or genocidal, such as the fighting in Croatia and the Krajina, or the wars taken as a whole.

label: Kosovo
description: Speeches invoking the Kosovo conflict and the expulsion of its Albanian population as genocide or genocidal.

label: Darfur
description: Speeches invoking the conflict in Darfur as genocide or genocidal.

label: DRC and the Great Lakes
description: Speeches invoking mass killing in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and the wider Great Lakes region as genocide or genocidal.

label: Democratic Republic of the Congo
description: Speeches invoking mass killing in the Democratic Republic of the Congo as genocide or genocidal, including the presence in its east of armed groups formed from the perpetrators of the Rwandan killings.

label: Burundi
description: Speeches invoking the mass violence in Burundi as genocide or genocidal.

label: Iraqi Kurds and Anfal
description: Speeches invoking the Anfal campaign and the Halabja attack against Iraq's Kurdish population as genocide or genocidal.

label: East Timor
description: Speeches invoking the violence around East Timor's independence ballot as genocide or genocidal.

label: Cambodia under the Khmer Rouge
description: Speeches invoking the mass killing under the Khmer Rouge, including the work of the Extraordinary Chambers, as genocide or genocidal.

label: Bangladesh and the war of separation
description: Speeches invoking the mass killing during the war that separated East Pakistan from Pakistan as genocide or genocidal.

label: ISIL and the Yazidis
description: Speeches invoking ISIL's campaign against the Yazidi population of northern Iraq as genocide or genocidal.

label: ISIL and other populations of Iraq and Syria
description: Speeches invoking ISIL's crimes against populations of Iraq and Syria other than the Yazidis as genocide or genocidal, such as Christians, Shia Muslims and Turkmen.

label: Syria
description: Speeches invoking the conduct of the parties to the war in Syria as genocide or genocidal.

label: Myanmar and the Rohingya
description: Speeches invoking the treatment of the Rohingya population of Myanmar as genocide or genocidal.

label: South Sudan
description: Speeches invoking the civil war in South Sudan as genocide or genocidal.

label: Central African Republic
description: Speeches invoking the sectarian violence in the Central African Republic as genocide or genocidal.

label: Xinjiang and the Uyghurs
description: Speeches invoking China's treatment of the Uyghur population of Xinjiang as genocide or genocidal.

label: Muslims in India
description: Speeches invoking the treatment of the Muslim population of India as genocide or genocidal.

label: Afghanistan and the Hazaras
description: Speeches invoking mass violence in Afghanistan as genocide or genocidal, in particular attacks on its Hazara population.

label: Nagorno-Karabakh
description: Speeches invoking the Nagorno-Karabakh conflict and the departure of its Armenian population as genocide or genocidal.

label: Khojaly
description: Speeches invoking the killings at Khojaly as genocide or genocidal, which Azerbaijan raises as an event of its own.

label: Abkhazia and South Ossetia
description: Speeches invoking the conflicts in Abkhazia and South Ossetia and the displacement of their populations as genocide or genocidal.

label: Crimean Tatars
description: Speeches invoking the wartime deportation of the Crimean Tatars, or their treatment under the occupation of Crimea, as genocide or genocidal.

label: Ukraine since 2022
description: Speeches invoking genocide in connection with the war in Ukraine, in either direction: against Russia's conduct and in Russia's own claims about Donbas.

label: Ukraine
description: Speeches invoking genocide in connection with the war in Ukraine, in either direction: against Russia's conduct and in Russia's own claims about Donbas. Not the Soviet famine, which holodomor covers, and not the Crimean Tatars, who have their own identifier.

label: Israel and Palestine
description: Speeches invoking Israeli conduct towards Palestinians, or the conduct of Palestinian and allied armed groups towards Israelis, as genocide or genocidal, up to the war that gaza covers.

label: Gaza
description: Speeches invoking the Gaza war as genocide or genocidal, including the proceedings South Africa brought against Israel at the ICJ.

label: South Africa under apartheid
description: Speeches invoking apartheid and the violence surrounding its end as genocide or genocidal.

label: United States embargo against Cuba
description: Speeches describing the United States embargo against Cuba as genocidal.

label: Other sanctions regimes
description: Speeches describing a sanctions regime other than the Cuban embargo as genocidal, such as the measures against Iraq in the 1990s.

label: The Holocaust
description: Speeches invoking the Nazi extermination of European Jews and its commemoration as genocide or genocidal.

label: The Ottoman Armenians
description: Speeches invoking the deportation and mass killing of Ottoman Armenians as genocide or genocidal.

label: The Soviet famine in Ukraine
description: Speeches invoking the Soviet famine in Ukraine as genocide or genocidal, which speakers raise as a case of its own rather than as part of the war that ukraine covers.

label: Colonial-era mass violence
description: Speeches invoking mass violence under colonial rule as genocide or genocidal, such as the campaign against the Herero and Nama.

label: Genocide in general
description: Abstract discussion of genocide, including prevention doctrine, with no single case in view.

label: Genocide Convention and legal definition
description: The 1948 Convention, the legal definition of the crime, and jurisdiction over it before the ICJ or the ICC.

label: Institutional title or mandate
description: The name or mandate of an office or body, such as the Special Adviser on the Prevention of Genocide or a tribunal's title.

label: Prospective or unnamed genocide
description: Warnings that a genocide may come where no specific past or present case is named.
